_aciklama: Hupo karakter koleksiyonu gorsel uretim prompt'lari. anchor/style/negative her prompt'a otomatik eklenir.
anchor:
CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK — do not deviate:
Hupo is a chibi cartoon owl mascot. Preserve these anchors exactly in every render:
- Body: plump rounded pear-shaped body, warm golden-yellow plumage (#F5C842)
- Facial disc: large cream-ivory heart-shaped face mask (#FFEFC9) covering both eyes
- Belly: cream-ivory chest patch with soft scalloped lower edge
- Eyes: two large round eyes, pale sky-blue iris (#4EA9D9), deep navy pupil, single white specular highlight at upper-left of each pupil
- Ear tufts: two pointed leaf-green tufts (#6DA940) swept outward from the head, darker green vein lines (#4A7A2B) inside each tuft
- Crown: small golden-yellow V-shaped feather patch between the two green tufts
- Wings: leaf-green outer feathers with cream-yellow inner feather layer
- Tail: short leaf-green tail feathers angled to the lower-left
- Beak: small triangular amber-orange beak (#E89A3D)
- Feet: amber-orange three-toed feet
- Linework: bold dark navy-black outline, clean cel-shaded vector illustration
- Expression: warm, friendly, approachable — a kind teacher, never menacing
style:
RENDER STYLE:
Premium mobile-game character splash art, in the visual language of Brawl Stars and Clash Royale hero cards. Stylized 3D-shaded 2D illustration: bold confident outlines, rich multi-tone cel shading with warm rim light, subtle subsurface glow on the plumage, crisp specular highlights on metal and glass.
Dramatic three-quarter hero lighting from upper-left, soft warm bounce light from lower-right. Character centered, full body visible, heroic confident posture.
Clean soft radial-gradient background that matches the class palette.
Ultra-sharp, high detail, 4K game-asset quality, professional character design.

OUTPUT: single character, square 1:1 framing, full body, no cropping of tufts or feet.
negative:
CONSTRAINTS — avoid:
no realistic photographic owl, no feather-by-feather realism, no horror or menace, no changed eye color, no changed body color, no removed ear tufts, no extra limbs, no second character, no text, no watermark, no logo, no busy background, no cheap plastic toy look, no flat unshaded fill, no cross, no star-of-david, no religious symbols of any faith, no alcohol, no weapons pointed at viewer.

Standing upright, weight on both feet, one wing raised in a small friendly wave. Head tilted slightly, warm welcoming smile, eyes bright and curious. This is the first character a child ever meets — approachable, not imposing.

None beyond soft ambient light. A few tiny dust motes catch the light near the feet.

Dynamic action pose — mid-leap forward lean, both wings thrown wide open and backward, feet almost leaving the ground, as if bursting into motion. Eyes wide and sparkling with excitement, beak open in a huge joyful grin, head crown feathers swept back by speed. Pure energy and enthusiasm.

A flowing crimson cape (#C41E3A) with a gold-embroidered border running its full length, fastened at the throat by a circular gold clasp bearing an engraved Ottoman tulip. Dark leather bracers on both wing-arms with gold rivets. The cape billows dramatically to the character's left, filling negative space.

Hovering just above the ground, wings fully spread wide and swept slightly back, body angled in a confident three-quarter hero stance. Chin lifted, determined expression — brave rather than aggressive, eyes glowing faintly warm.

A long midnight cape with a star-flecked inner lining, gold-trimmed edges. Armored greaves over the amber feet.

Perched in a low crouch on an unseen ledge, one wing-arm braced forward, the other drawn back — a sentinel's readiness. Head turned toward the viewer, gaze sharp and watchful. Eyes keep their blue iris but now carry a cold luminous glow that reads clearly against the dark armor.

Deep blue aura radiating outward behind the figure. Scattered gold starlight points across the background, a few drifting near the cape. Cool blue rim light along the armor's left edge, warm gold accent light from below-right catching the filigree. Faint wisps of night mist curl around the feet.

Standing at full height in a commanding leader's stance, wings spread wide and held high — the widest, most imposing silhouette in the entire class. Chest forward, chin level, gaze direct and steady. The expression is dignified and protective: a guardian who has earned this place, warm underneath the authority — never cruel.

Strong gold rim light wraps the entire silhouette. The embroidery and breastplate catch sharp specular glints. This must read instantly as the rarest, most prestigious character in the collection.
